pages.title: Missing Recipes
pages.text: Check BiblioCraft’s common config and any modpack recipe changes. Turning a feature off can hide its creative entries, remove its recipes and placement, or disable its interaction. An unavailable recipe page can still show its notes.

pages.title: Common Settings
pages.text: Look in config/bibliocraft-common.toml. blocks_enabled controls features. recipes.enable_lock_recipe enables the gold key. rendering.emit_light controls display light. rendering.disable_renderers skips furniture displays.

pages.title: Missing Textures
pages.text: If furniture is visible but displayed items are missing, check the renderer setting. If a saved framed item shows a default texture, restore its companion mod or apply a new panel. The saved panel ID remains with the item.

pages.title: Existing Worlds
pages.text: Saves from earlier BiblioCraft Forge 1.20.1 builds keep their registry IDs and furniture data. Back up a world before upgrading. The 1.20.1 port does not directly convert BiblioCraft content from 1.12.2 worlds.

pages.title: Getting Help
pages.text: Use the $(l:bibliocraft:getting_started/first_shelf)first shelf$(/l) walkthrough to check basic placement and storage. A missing display recipe may depend on its material or on $(l:bibliocraft:materials/bibliowoods)installed wood mods$(/l).
